anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, indicating potential inactivity or misconfiguration.
Trading metrics show no active or closed trades, which might be expected but could indicate inactivity.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review AI system configuration and ensure it is properly set up to generate learning cycles and opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and market conditions to ensure they align with current goals and market opportunities.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate review of CPU usage and identify processes causing high load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and affect platform performance, impacting user experience.

recommendations.action: Audit AI system configuration and logs to diagnose why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity could mean missed trading opportunities and reduced platform competitiveness.

recommendations.action: Assess the current trading strategies and market conditions to ensure they are still relevant and effective.
recommendations.rationale: Aligning strategies with market conditions can improve trading outcomes and platform profitability.
